record.question: A drug that is listed under NLEM is considered as:
options: An essential medicine needed for priority healthcare needs of the population
Drugs that focus on the maternal & child health needs of the population
List of drugs that aims to target the endemic diseases of a particular area
An essential list of medicines that will target life-threatening conditions
record.explanation: Answer A: An essential medicine needed for priority healthcare needs of the population. An essential medicine meets the priority healthcare needs of a population and should be available in appropriate dosage forms, assured quality, and affordable cost. Reference: https://www.who.int/news-room/fact-sheets/detail/essential-medicines. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Original printed wording and option order reviewed; no matching examiner key is asserted.
